well_01.title: The Well Part 1: Six Sick | It Was Not A Bite
well_01.hook: If six people get sick on the same morning, don't look for a bite.
well_01.premise: A village of 41 people has one well. When six people fall sick at once, everyone blames the dead. Only the water tester knows to check the water.
well_01.tip: Real tip: sickness in many people at once, with no wound, points to bad water. Boil suspect water for at least 1 minute (3 minutes above 2,000 m).
well_01.ask: Would you have opened the barn or kept the sick locked in? Tell me below.

well_02.title: The Well Part 2: The Boiling Point | Clean Water Without Fire
well_02.hook: If you cannot boil it, you can still clean it.
well_02.premise: The village well is contaminated, but fire means smoke and smoke calls the dead. Nell finds three ways to make water safe and learns who really opened the well.
well_02.tip: Real tips: boil 1 minute, or leave clear PET bottles in full sun for 6 hours (SODIS), or add 8 drops of plain 6% bleach per gallon and wait 30 minutes. For the sick: 1 liter boiled water + 6 teaspoons sugar + half a teaspoon salt. Keep latrines at least 30 m from a well.
well_02.ask: Which of the three ways would you try first? Tell me below.

well_03.title: The Well Part 3: The Handle | Your Well Squeaks, Zombies Hear It
well_03.hook: If your well squeaks, it is a dinner bell.
well_03.premise: To clean the well the village must pump it hundreds of times, and every squeak calls the dead. Nell finds a way to pump in silence.
well_03.tip: Real tips: move latrines 30 m or more from the well, seal the lid, disinfect and pump the well out several times. Wrap and grease noisy handles so the sound does not carry.
well_03.ask: Would you have trusted boiled water that tastes bad? Tell me below.

harvest_01.title: The Harvest Part 1: Nineteen Days | Plant Today Or Starve
harvest_01.hook: If you only have 19 days of food, plant today.
harvest_01.premise: A village with 41 mouths and 19 days of food must grow a harvest before winter. Fast crops, a seed jar, and one hungry mayor.
harvest_01.tip: Real tips: fast crops first (radish about 25 days, lettuce about 30, spinach about 40), plant in spots with at least 6 hours of sun, and never eat the last seed.
harvest_01.ask: Would you eat the seeds or plant them? Tell me below.

harvest_02.title: The Harvest Part 2: The Rattle | Scare Deer, Not The Dead
harvest_02.hook: If you scare crows with noise, you scare up the dead.
harvest_02.premise: Something is digging up the seed beds. A noisy scarecrow solves one problem and invites a worse one.
harvest_02.tip: Real tips: protect crops with a tall fence (about 1.8 m), silent shiny strips and raised beds. Noise attracts zombies, so never use rattles.
harvest_02.ask: What would you use to guard a garden quietly? Tell me below.

harvest_03.title: The Harvest Part 3: The Cold Smokehouse | Keep Food Without Smoke
harvest_03.hook: If you smoke meat, the dead can smell your dinner.
harvest_03.premise: The harvest is in, but smoke calls the dead. Gran Oda and Nell keep food for winter without a fire.
harvest_03.tip: Real tips: preserve by salting, drying and keeping food cool and dark (a cellar about 1.5 m deep stays cool). Never taste-test: bulging jars or bad smells go in the bin.
harvest_03.ask: Would you trust a cellar over a smokehouse? Tell me below.

signal_01.title: The Signal Part 1: Static | Listen Before You Answer
signal_01.hook: If you hear a voice on the radio, do not answer yet. Listen first.
signal_01.premise: A kid finds a hand-crank radio. A voice repeats a grid number in the static. Should he answer?
signal_01.tip: Real tips: hand-crank radios need no batteries; listen on emergency channels (121.5 MHz aviation emergency, CB channel 9, the 162 MHz weather band); write down what you hear before you transmit.
signal_01.ask: Would you answer the voice or keep listening? Tell me below.

signal_02.title: The Signal Part 2: The Mirror | 3 Flashes Mean Help
signal_02.hook: If you only have one mirror, you have a signal you can see for miles.
signal_02.premise: The village answers with light. A compact mirror, a V of fingers and three flashes.
signal_02.tip: Real tips: aim a signal mirror through a V made with your fingers; three flashes mean help; on a sunny day a flash can be seen 15 km or more.
signal_02.ask: Have you ever tried a signal mirror? Tell me below.

signal_03.title: The Signal Part 3: Three Fires | Signal Without Calling The Dead
signal_03.hook: If you light a signal fire, you also light a dinner bell.
signal_03.premise: Three fires mean help to the world, and dinner to the dead. The village lights them far from home.
signal_03.tip: Real tips: three of anything (fires, whistle blasts, flashes) is the international distress signal; keep fires far from your shelter so smoke does not lead threats to you.
signal_03.ask: Would you light the fires on the wall or the ridge? Tell me below.

signal_04.title: The Signal Part 4: The Reply | What To Do When They Answer
signal_04.hook: If someone answers your signal, stay where they can find you.
signal_04.premise: Headlights on the ridge. A voice on the radio. The village learns what to do when help finally answers.
signal_04.tip: Real tips: stay where you signalled, keep supplies together, and leave a note if you have to move.
signal_04.ask: Would you wait or walk toward the lights? Tell me below.
